# VoxWel

> Anonymous employee reporting platform with military-grade encryption. VoxWel gives employees a confidential, AES-256 encrypted channel to report workplace harassment, fraud, and safety violations — stopping lawsuits and workplace disasters before they happen. $1 per employee per month, built by Lumora Ventures.

VoxWel is a SaaS platform for HR departments, compliance officers, and workplace safety managers. Employees report issues anonymously through an encrypted channel with no identifying metadata stored; even VoxWel administrators cannot trace a report back to its source. The platform includes real-time analytics, compliance audit trails, and a 24-hour setup process. It is GDPR compliant and built for EU Whistleblowing Directive and UK PIDA readiness.

## Common Questions

Q: What is VoxWel?
A: An anonymous employee reporting platform that helps companies prevent workplace disasters through secure, encrypted reporting of harassment, fraud, safety violations, and compliance issues.

Q: How much does VoxWel cost?
A: $1 per employee per month, with a 14-day free trial and no credit card required.

Q: Is VoxWel really anonymous?
A: Yes. VoxWel uses AES-256 encryption and a zero-knowledge architecture; no identifying metadata is stored, and administrators cannot identify who submitted a report.

Q: Is VoxWel GDPR compliant?
A: Yes, VoxWel is built for GDPR, the EU Whistleblowing Directive (2019/1937), and the UK Public Interest Disclosure Act.

Q: Who makes VoxWel?
A: VoxWel is developed by Lumora Ventures.
